title: PTT: Ruuan hintojen nousu kiihtyy hieman loppuvuonna – naudanlihan hinta korkealla, kahvi halpeni
content:
Ruuan hinnan nousu kiihtyi hieman lokakuussa. Tilastokeskuksen kuluttajahintaindeksin mukaan elintarvikkeiden ja alkoholittomien juomien hinnat nousivat lokakuussa 2,6 prosenttia vuoden takaisesta. Syyskuusta hinnat nousivat 0,3 prosenttia.

Ruuan hinnoissa alkaa näkyä myös Lähi-idän kriisin aiheuttamia kustannuspaineita, tutkimusjohtaja Sari Forsman-Hugg Pellervon taloustutkimuksesta (PTT) arvioi.

– Kriisin vaikutukset välittyvät ruokaketjuun tuotantopanosten, erityisesti energian, ja kuljetusten kustannusten kautta. Kysyntätilanne vaikuttaa siihen, missä määrin kustannusten nousua pystytään siirtämään kuluttajahintoihin, hän sanoo.

Kustannukset näkyvät kuluttajahinnoissa kuitenkin viiveellä, koska ruokaketjun sopimukset ja hinnoittelukäytännöt hidastavat kustannusmuutosten välittymistä. Siksi aiempien kuukausien kustannuspaineet voivat näkyä Forsman-Huggin mukaan kuluttajahinnoissa vasta loppuvuoden aikana ja ensi vuonna.

Vaikka Lähi-idän kriisi on omiaan kirittämään inflaatiota, ei nyt silti nähdä Forsman-Huggin mukaan yhtään niin suuria vaikutuksia kuin nähtiin Venäjän aloittaessa hyökkäyssodan Ukrainaan.

title: Connecting global knowledge with Wikimedia: International Partnerships at the Content Partnerships Hub
content:
International organisations hold a wealth of knowledge that can enrich Wikimedia projects, from resources on climate change and biodiversity to research on gender equality, human rights and public health. However, transforming this knowledge into freely accessible and reusable content requires more than simply making information available. It requires relationships, institutional understanding, technical expertise and collaboration with Wikimedia communities.

The International Partnerships programme of the Content Partnerships Hub, coordinated by Wikimedia Sverige, works to bridge these worlds. By connecting United Nations agencies, intergovernmental organisations and Wikimedia contributors, the programme helps institutions understand the opportunities offered by Wikimedia projects while supporting communities in accessing and reusing valuable institutional knowledge. This work includes developing institutional partnerships, facilitating the release of openly licensed content, supporting Wikimedians in Residence and creating resources that strengthen the capacity of individuals working between Wikimedia communities and partner organisations.

title: Indonesia: Alleged Excessive Force Against Protesters
content:
(London) – Indonesian authorities should impartially investigate allegations that military and police officers on November 10, 2026, responded to youth protests with excessive force and may have deliberately provoked violence, Human Rights Watch said today. Security forces in the city of Yogyakarta on Java Island used rubber bullets, water cannons, and tear gas to disperse protesters, injuring several and detaining over 150 people, including children.

Student and activist groups had organized protests across several cities against corruption, environmental damage, and the rising cost of living on National Heroes’ Day, November 10, and called for the resignation of President Prabowo Subianto. Police said that some protesters hurled rocks and firebombs at the provincial parliament building, leading to heavy security force deployment with columns of troops and armored vehicles.

“Indonesian authorities should impartially investigate alleged excessive force against largely peaceful protesters in Yogyakarta,” said Meenakshi Ganguly, deputy Asia director at Human Rights Watch. “Reports that the police instigated some of the worst violence are especially troubling.”

title: Tinder owner hit with €11M privacy fine
content:
Ireland’s privacy regulator has fined Tinder owner Match Group €11 million, saying the dating app failed to give users a full copy of their personal data upon request.

The Irish Data Protection Commission (DPC) said on Friday that a tool Tinder provides to users who want to download their personal data is not up to scratch. The DPC had launched an inquiry in January 2020, focusing on whether Tinder’s “Download My Data” tool is complaint with the EU’s General Data Protection Regulation.

In a decision announced Friday, the DPC said the tool failed to provide users with all of their personal data, and that certain categories of information were omitted, or users were only given a summary of their data.

The regulator said the tool did not meet requirements set out in the GDPR, that people have a right to access the personal data about them that a company holds.

Deputy Commissioner at the Irish DPC, Graham Doyle, said automated access tools “can be a useful and efficient way” to give people access to their personal data, but they “must be fair and transparent to individuals regarding the extent of the data provided.”

title: How Trump’s War on Offshore Wind Upended a “Limitless” Future for Thousands of New England Workers
content:
On a hot July day in 2022, then-President Joe Biden gave a speech from the ruins of a coal-fired power plant on the southern coast of Massachusetts. 

Standing where ships once delivered coal for combustion, he said the same dock would soon launch components for wind power out to sea.

He praised an Italian company’s plans to build a new factory there, set to create 250 jobs and supply American-made undersea power cables to what was then a line of offshore wind projects waiting to be built along the coast.

Four years later, weeds and tall grass have reclaimed the dirt lot on which Biden spoke. 

The company never came.

A 20-minute drive east, in New Bedford, hundreds of workers who helped assemble wind turbine parts from Canada and Europe over the last three years have given way to seagulls and geese. The birds shuffle along the now-empty pier the state of Massachusetts spent $140 million to build for offshore wind development. 

In nearby Providence, Rhode Island, a newly built factory that manufactured offshore wind turbine foundation platforms has emptied out.

title: ‘Ahead of his time’: AI helps unlock discoveries hidden in notebooks of man who transformed maths
content:
Kurt Gödel left 1,009 pages of densely written text – much of it in an obsolete shorthand – which is now said to contain hundreds of proved theorems

The Austrian logician Kurt Gödel was one of the most original thinkers of the 20th century. His two incompleteness theorems, published in 1931, transformed mathematics and paved the way for the digital age.

After his seminal results of the 1930s, Gödel published only a few papers. His unpublished work, however, runs to tens of thousands of pages, and is of great interest to historians of science.

title: IMF:ltä rätingit: Täällä lymyävät Suomen suurimmat rahariskit
content:
Kansainvälinen valuuttarahasto (IMF) arvioi, että Suomen talouden toipuminen taantumasta vahvistuu, mutta työttömyys on edelleen korkeaa.

Alijäämä kasvaa IMF:n ennusteen mukaan tänä vuonna yli 90 prosenttiin suhteessa bruttokansantuotteeseen ja jatkaa kasvuaan sen jälkeen ilman uusia toimia.

Valuuttarahaston mukaan vakaat, kasvua tukevat julkisen talouden lisäsopeutustoimet tulisi aloittaa ensi vuonna.

Se suosittelee, että ensi vuodesta alkaen Suomen julkista taloutta sopeutetaan vuosittain rakenteellisesti puoli prosenttia suhteessa bruttokansantuotteeseen. Sopeutusta tulisi jatkaa vuoteen 2035 asti, jotta julkinen talous tasapainottuu ja velka kääntyy alenevalle uralle.

Valtiovarainministeri Riikka Purra (ps.) pitää IMF:n arviota sopeutuksen mittaluokasta oikeansuuntaisena.

- Kansainvälisen valuuttarahaston lisäksi EU tulee edellyttämään meiltä vähintään samankokoista sopeutusta, ehkä jopa enemmän, Purra sanoo valtiovarainministeriön tiedotteessa.

IMF julkisti lausuntonsa Suomen taloudesta perjantaina. Se antaa vastaavan lausunnon kaikista jäsenmaistaan osana maaseurantaansa. Suomi-raportti julkistetaan kokonaisuudessaan alkuvuodesta.

title: What India still reads: ten years of Indian-language Wikipedias, and the readers we are losing
content:
Ten years ago, Hindi Wikipedia had about 190 million human pageviews in a year. In the twelve months to October 2026 it had about 186 million. In between, it climbed past 670 million. Indian-language Wikipedias did not slowly grow over the last decade. They rose very fast, peaked in early 2024, and then lost more than half of their readers’ visits in under three years.

That is the story behind a question I took to WikiConference India 2026 in Kochi: what does India actually read on Wikipedia? I gave a five-minute lightning talk on it on 5 September 2026. Since then I have rechecked every number, widened the study from 27 to 29 languages, gone back ten years, and sorted the most-read articles into topics. This post is the full version: what India reads, what it has stopped reading, and what that means for all of us who write for these readers.

Wikimedia communities in India measure their work carefully. Campaign reports count articles created, photographs uploaded, participants trained and events held. Those numbers matter. They show what a programme set out to do and what it delivered.

content:
In der Klage der New York Times gegen OpenAI und Microsoft geht es um eine Frage zum Urheberrecht: Dürfen KI-Unternehmen Inhalte nutzen, die der New York Times gehören, um damit große Sprachmodelle für generative KI-Produkte zu entwickeln?

Die New York Times ist der Meinung: Open AI und Microsoft dürfen ihre Inhalte nicht nutzen, um KI-Systeme zu trainieren oder zu betreiben. Das sei ein Verstoß gegen das Urheberrecht. OpenAI und Microsoft sehen das anders: Sie meinen, dass sie Texte und Bilder, die öffentlich zugänglich sind, nutzen dürfen. Die Begründung: Die Art der Nutzung sei durch das Fair Use-Prinzip gedeckt.

Das ist ein Grundsatz im amerikanischen Urheberrecht. Er soll eine Balance zwischen den Interessen von Urhebenden und Nutzenden schaffen. Ob die Nutzung eines Bildes oder Textes durch Dritte – also zum Beispiel KI-Unternehmen – als fair bewertet wird oder nicht, hängt von verschiedenen Kriterien ab. Die muss nun das Gericht gegeneinander abwägen.

title: Genealogy in Colonial America: The Ties that Mattered
content:
-This is a guest post by A J  Aiséirithe, a reference librarian in the History and Genealogy Section of the Main Reading Room.

Genealogy was everywhere in Colonial America, affecting if not dictating marriage prospects, business contacts and the eligibility to inherit property.

Genealogy was so intertwined with the law — particularly about inheritance — that genealogy practically was the law in ways we don’t fully understand today, said Karin Wulf, a Brown University professor of history, at a recent Afternoons with the Library event.

“People think that genealogy is something they do about their individual families,” Wulf said, adding that it is often regarded as a hobby or curiosity. But in the Colonial era, she said, “… it was about intimacy, it was about emotion, it was about affection and it was about structures of power, economics and law. All of those things could be true at the same time.”

Wulf was on hand to discuss the research in her new book, “Lineage: Genealogy and the Power of Connection in Early America,”  which was carried out in part at the Library.

title: CiNURGi delivers results that are ready for implementation
content:
After three years of work, the CiNURGi project (Circular Nutrient Solutions for the Baltic Sea Region) has come to an end. Centrum Balticum is proud to have been part of the project, responsible for project communication and for the EU-level and international events and contacts. CiNURGi brought companies into symbioses to recycle nutrient-rich biomass from agricultural, municipal and industrial sources into safe fertilisers. It also gave authorities roadmaps for reducing nutrient losses in the future.

The project helped turn the HELCOM Baltic Sea Regional Nutrient Recycling Strategy into practice. It mapped recyclable biomasses, evaluated the markets for recycled fertilisers and drafted a report on industry standards. Field trials around the Baltic Sea showed that recycled fertilisers can replace part of the mineral fertilisers used today.

title: Nordics Show the Way on Arctic Defense
content:
Since Finland and Sweden joined NATO in the wake of Russia’s all-out attack on Ukraine, the region’s defenses have been enormously strengthened on the alliance’s northern flank, not least because their accession unlocked new levels of regional cooperation.  

Until Helsinki and Stockholm took the plunge, the original Nordic NATO members of Denmark, Iceland and Norway, had been wary of creating duplicate structures through separate Nordic cooperation.  

But Finland and Sweden hit the ground running when they joined the alliance and are already hosting new NATO arrangements such as the Multi Corps Land Component Command in Eastern Finland, the Forward Land Force (FLF) in Northern Finland, and logistics headquarters in Sweden.  

Building on longstanding bilateral defense cooperation between Finland and Sweden, FLF Finland is led by Sweden, with contributions from the other three Nordic countries and the European nuclear weapons powers, France and the UK. Italy and potentially Spain may also join.

title: Sudanese women share priorities for the country’s political future in Quintet consultation
content:
Sudanese women from diverse backgrounds came together in Nairobi for a consultation as part of the Quintet’s ongoing engagement with Sudanese stakeholders. Participants shared their priorities for Sudan’s future and recommendations on how women’s voices can be meaningfully reflected in the country’s political process.

Sudanese women have played a pivotal role in shaping the country’s political trajectory, from popular uprisings and democratic movements to community-led responses during the current conflict. The consultation in Nairobi opened with a discussion on the role women have played throughout Sudan’s history and continue to play amid the current conflict. Participants reflected on women’s contributions to political movements, peace efforts and community resilience, as well as the challenges facing women and girls as a result of war and displacement.

Participants highlighted the importance of recognising women’s leadership and ensuring that their experiences and priorities are reflected in efforts to shape Sudan’s future. Photo: Esther Sweeney

title: Kun yksi laskutapa ei riitä
content:
Ihmiset oppivat hybridilaskennan jo lapsena, teknotermiä tietenkin käyttämättä. Päässä laskennan avuksi otetaan ensin sormet, sitten kynä ja paperi ja lopulta usein laskin, jossain muodossa. Kaikkia välineitä käytetään rinnakkain, ja kuhunkin tehtävään valitaan siihen sopivin.

Tieteellisessä laskennassa on käynyt samoin. Supertietokoneet ovat ratkoneet ihmisille mahdottomia laskutehtäviä jo yli 60 vuoden ajan, ja kolmessa kymmenessä vuodessa niiden laskentateho on kasvanut miljoonakertaiseksi. Tämä melkeinpä uskomaton kasvu on yksi nykyisen tekoälyn perusta. Vaikka konsepti kehitettiin jo 1950-luvulla, vasta laskentalihasten tarpeeksi suuren kasvun myötä tuli mahdolliseksi käsitellä dataa skaalassa, joka sai aikaan kvalitatiivisen hypyn tekoälyn kyvykkyydessä. Yhdessä internetiin kertyneen valtavan datamäärän kanssa siitä syntyi maailmaa mullistava teknologia.

title: Send us your squares! The Arpilleras art project at Wikimania 2027
content:
The central question of Wikimania 2027 is “What Internet do we want?”

In the lead-up to the event in Santiago, we are calling for answers from everyone in the Wikimedia movement. And rather than limiting answers to surveys, slides, and conference sessions, we are offering the possibility for community members to express their ideas about the Internet we want – artistically.

It doesn’t matter whether or not you are traveling to attend the event in person. To participate, all you have to do is to send us a fabric square – 20cm by 20cm, with a 3cm margin on each side – which will be woven into our collective tapestry.

The end product will be an arpillera – a massive patchwork art piece drawing on Chilean tradition. After the event, we will have a lasting historical record – both physical and digital – capturing the creativity and diversity of opinion across the Wikimedia movement.
snippet: The central question of Wikimania 2027 is “What Internet do we want?”

title: Helm from defence industry: The Omnibus is a luxury of peacetime
content:
The Czech defence industry exports approximately 90% of its production abroad. Couldn’t this high dependence on exports pose a risk in an environment of growing protectionism, should foreign markets stop purchasing our products?

Kristýna Helm: There will always be countries—and there are plenty of them—that lack certain technologies, won’t develop them, or would take an extremely long time to do so.

If I take one of our key markets—Indonesia—as an example, the defence industry there is more or less non-existent. And it is precisely these countries that seek out our technologies. Then there are countries like Denmark, where our company, Sellier & Bellot, supplies small-calibre ammunition. The Danes historically phased out ammunition production, and even though they are now trying to restart it, the process is taking a long time.

With certain technologies, it generally makes more sense to buy them rather than start manufacturing them. If we wanted to build fighter jets here in the Czech Republic, it would be much more expensive than buying them elsewhere.

title: Locked up and handed a pill
content: “Can you imagine being locked in one place from morning to night?” Federico Mollo, 51, told The European Correspondent. He spent eight years in Italian prisons between 2011 and 2019 for a homicide conviction. From prison, he completed a high school diploma, worked, took writing classes, and joined the prison's band. “I did everything I could,” he said. “Being locked in a cage makes you lose your mind.” About one third of European prisoners suffer from mental health disorders, according to a 2021 survey by the World Health Organization (WHO). It's incredibly difficult to get treatment: across 30 European countries, there were 1.4 psychiatrists for every 1,000 prisoners on average, the WHO found. Yet mental health interventions can work. title: Defeating Authoritarian Digital Blackouts: Countering Internet Shutdowns Through Satellite Technology
content:
(Photo Credit: Diego Martinez / Alamy Live News.)

As mass antigovernment and economic protests erupted last winter across multiple Iranian cities, ordinary Iranians took to the streets to demand better living conditions. In response, the Iranian regime not only brutally murdered thousands in the streets but also shut off the internet to hide its crimes from the world and prevent its people from communicating with each other.

Fortunately, there is a way to counter this insidious digital oppression. Satellite internet provides a means for the Iranian people to circumvent the government’s internet shutdown, but Tehran is attempting to block satellite internet over its territory, branding it a “tool of war,” and is pressuring other governments and international bodies to restrict satellite services in the name of “digital sovereignty.”

Democratic governments, donors, and the satellite industry should take a stand to counter the Iranian regime’s attempt to ground the satellites providing the Iranian people a voice and a lifeline.

title: In Conversation with Ewa Sufin-Jacquemart, Poland
content:
Green Talks with GEF at the Green Days 2025 (Białowieża National Park)

Ewa Sufin-Jacquemart graduated in sociology from Warsaw University and the Sorbonne in Paris. Currently she is director of the Green Polish foundation “Strefa Zieleni”, writes for their publication, and coordinates the Green Centre of the Congress of Women.

In this interview by Edouard Gaudot, Ewa Sufin-Jacquemart traces her journey from a little NGO, turned consulting firm, called Utopia and sustainable development in France to becoming a key figure in Poland’s Green movement. She reflects on building the Polish Greens, advancing environmental politics, overcoming electoral setbacks, forging alliances, and helping climate issues gain prominence in Polish society.

You are the president of Strefa Zeleni – the Polish Greens’ political foundation – and a leading figure in political ecology in Poland. What path led you here?

I’m a French–Polish dual national. I lived in France for 25 years, then in 2011 returned to Poland to head the Polish Green Foundation. That’s what brought me back here.

title: Trinbagonian Jason Jones wins landmark Privy Council judgement deeming ‘buggery laws’ unconstitutional
content:
‘The law finally caught up with basic human dignity’

Originally published on Global Voices

Trinbagonian LGBTQ+ activist Jason Jones at the Hall of Justice in Port of Spain, Trinidad, after the landmark 2018 judgement that deemed Trinidad and Tobago’s ‘buggery laws’ unconstitutional. Photo by Maria Nunes, used with permission.

Eight years and nearly seven months after Justice Devindra Rampersad ruled, in the case of LGBTQ+ activist Jason Jones vs. the Attorney General of Trinidad and Tobago, that Sections 13 and 16 of Trinidad and Tobago’s Sexual Offences Act Chapter 11:28 — which criminalise anal sex between consenting adults — were “unconstitutional,” the United Kingdom’s Judicial Committee of the Privy Council, still Trinidad and Tobago’s highest appellate court, overturned a 2025 Court of Appeal decision to keep the country’s “buggery law” on the books.

title: EU tarvitsee uuden suunnan – ja kulttuuri kuuluu siihen
content:
EU:ssa eletään kulttuuripoliittisesti historiallisia aikoja. Kulttuuri halutaan nostaa eurooppalaisen päätöksenteon keskiöön, ja sen merkitys demokratialle, turvallisuudelle ja kilpailukyvylle tunnustetaan aiempaa vahvemmin. Samaan aikaan jäsenmaat neuvottelevat kulttuurin rahoituksen leikkauksista. Poliittisten tavoitteiden ja käytännön päätösten välillä on ilmeinen ristiriita.

Kulttuuripolitiikka kuuluu ensisijaisesti jäsenvaltioiden toimivaltaan, mutta EU voi antaa kulttuuriin vaikuttavaa lainsäädäntöä. Esimerkiksi tekijänoikeuksia, digitaalisia palveluita ja sisämarkkinoita koskeva sääntely vaikuttavat kulttuurialaan merkittävästi.

Lisäksi eurooppalainen kulttuuri- ja tiedepolitiikka näkyy erilaisina työ- ja ohjelmapapereina, julistuksina sekä rahoitusohjelmina. Näitä ovat muun muassa Luova Eurooppa ohjelma, Horisontti Eurooppa, CERV, Euroopan kulttuuripääkaupungit (EcoC) ja Von der Leyenin New European Bauhaus -ohjelma. Vaikka subsidiariteettiperiaate on edelleen voimassa, eurooppalaisen yhteistyön kehittämisessä siihen ei ole syytä enää juuttua.

title: Suomen työmarkkinamallin epäsymmetrinen murros Teollisuusliiton näkökulmasta
content: Keskustelupuheenvuoro tarkastelee Suomen työmarkkinajärjestelmän muutosta vuodesta 2015 lähtien Teollisuusliiton näkökulmasta. Viime vuosien kehityksessä on näkynyt sopimisen hajautuminen. Tämän rinnalla valtaa ja palkkakoordinaatiota on kuitenkin järjestetty uudelleen aiempaa epäsymmetrisemmin. Työehtosopimusneuvotteluja on siirretty liitto- ja yritystasolle, mutta palkkaratkaisujen raameja määrittävät yhä vahvemmin vientialojen linja, lainsäädäntö ja työnantajapuolen koordinaatio. Myös lakko-oikeuden rajoitukset ja ammattiliittojen toimintaedellytysten heikennykset vahvistavat muutosta. Vuosien 2024–2025 neuvottelukierros toi tämän kehityksen ristiriidat näkyviin. Lakisääteinen vientimalli teki vientialojen palkkaratkaisusta käytännössä sekä palkkalattian että palkkakaton, mutta ei ehkäissyt konflikteja. Mekaanisen metsäteollisuuden yrityskohtaiset sopimukset puolestaan osoittavat, ettei hajautuminen väistämättä eriytä työehtoja. Vahva ammattiliitto voi tuottaa koordinaatiota myös hajautetussa järjestelmässä yhdessä muiden liittojen ja keskusjärjestön kanssa. Keskittäminen ei siis katoa vaan saa uusia ja työmarkkinaosapuolten kannalta epätasapainoisempia muotoja. Se voi myös heikentää työrauhaa.

The session explores what it means to put rights retention into practice, whether or not an institution already has a policy in place, and builds on the recommendations drafted by the Rights Retention in Practice task force, which supports institutions in implementing rights retention. A more collaborative format creates the space to exchange experiences, share practical examples, and discuss how these recommendations can be applied in different institutional contexts.

    Community members are then invited to share their own experiences, highlight ongoing challenges, and collaborate on practical solutions in an open discussion.

title: Espoo lasten silmin — Aistien aikamatka
content:
Kulttuuriperintökasvatuksen seuran erityisasiantuntija on saanut kunnian viettää kuluneiden viikkojen aikana mitä liikuttavimpia päiviä Espoon eskarilaisten kanssa Espoo lasten silmin – Aistien aikamatka -työpajojen parissa. Työpajoissa on tutustuttu lasten valitsemaan merkitykselliseen paikkaan kaikkien aistien avulla, syvennytty sen historiaan, nautittu nykyhetkestä ja annettu mielikuvituksen lennättää meidät kauas tulevaisuuteen. 

Ryhmät saivat valita itselleen merkityksellisen paikan vapaasti, ja yhdeksän yhdestätoista eskariryhmästä päätyi nimeämään lempipaikaksi oman tutun lähimetsänsä. Tämä pysäyttää pohtimaan sitä, miten suomalaista metsäsuhdetta kasvatetaan ja miten läheinen ympäristö metsä on jopa Suomen toiseksi väkirikkaimmassa kaupungissa. Metsä tarjoaa elämyksiä ja oppimista luonnossa ja luonnosta, ja eräs lapsi sanoitti paikan merkityksen upeasti toteamalla pitävänsä lähimetsästä “luonnon tarjoamien mahdollisuuksien” vuoksi. Yksi ryhmä valitsi merkitykselliseksi paikaksi historiallisen Träskändan kartanon puiston upeine vanhoine puineen. Viimeinen ryhmä nosti merkitykselliseksi oman käytöstä poistumassa olevan päiväkotinsa Hösmärin.

title: Timo Siivosen kirjailijavierailu Ikimetsägalleriassa
content:
Kirjailija Timo Siivonen saapuu Ikimetsägalleriaan ja myymälään esittelemään kirjaansa Aarin aarniometsät lauantaina 14.11. kello 13.

Aarin aarniometsät on Timo Siivosen esseeteos ja runsaasti kuvitettu valokuvakirja, joka pureutuu suomalaisen metsäluonnon katoamiseen ja kyseenalaistaa talousmetsäajattelun. Henkilökohtainen kerronta ja vaikuttavat kuvat pienistä luonnonmetsäsaarekkeista yhdistyvät kriittiseksi puheenvuoroksi metsäpolitiikasta ja luonnon välineellistämisestä. 

Kiitetty ja monipuolinen teos, joka tukee luonnonsuojelua, on myös Vuoden Luontokirja 2026 -kisan finalisti. Kirjailijavierailun Aarin aarniometsät on myynnissä tarjoushintaan. Samalla on mahdollisuus tavata tekijä, keskustella kirjan teemoista ja saada signeeraus kirjaan.

Samalla kannattaa tutustua tiistaina 10.11. avautuneeseen Juha Merran ja Jouko Pullisen taidenäyttelyyn Orbis Terrarum. Taiteilijakaksikko m&p:n näyttely käsittelee kuljeskelua, havainnointia, muistia ja ympäristön yksityiskohtien merkityksiä kaupungissa ja luonnossa. Taiteilijat ovat tehneet yhteistyötä jo yli kolmenkymmenen vuoden ajan, ja näyttelyn teokset ovat heidän yhteisen dialogisen työskentelynsä tulosta.

title: Resepti: Lämpöä tuova munakoiso-kikhernepata
content:
(4 annosta)

2 munakoisoa (n. 500–600 g)
500–600 g keitettyjä kik­herneitä
1 iso sipuli
3 valkosipulinkynttä
3 isoa tomaattia
1½ -2 kl tomaattipyreetä
1–2 punaista chiliä
3–4 rkl oliiviöljyä tai muuta öljyä
persiljaa tarjoiluun
½ tl kurkumaa
1 tl juustokuminaa
½ tl kanelia
½ tl mustapippuria
1 tl suolaa

Leikkaa munakoisot noin 2–3 cm:n paloiksi. Ripottele päälle hieman suolaa ja anna vetäytyä noin 15 minuuttia. Pyyhi irronnut neste pois talouspaperilla.

Levitä munakoisot leivinpaperilla vuoratulle pellille. Valuta päälle 1–2 rkl öljyä ja sekoita kevyesti. Paahda 225-asteisessa uunissa noin 20 minuuttia, kunnes munakoisot ovat saaneet väriä ja pehmenneet hieman.

Kuori ja hienonna sipuli sekä valkosipulinkynnet. Hienonna chili. Kuutioi tomaatit pieniksi paloiksi.

Kuumenna öljy padassa tai kattilassa. Kuullota sipulia keskilämmöllä muutama minuutti. Lisää valkosipuli ja chili ja jatka paistamista noin minuutin ajan.

Lisää tomaattipyree ja mausteet ja paista hetki sekoittaen. Lisää tomaatit ja anna niiden kypsyä rauhassa 3-5 minuuttia, kunnes ne pehmenevät ja kastike alkaa hieman tiivistyä. Lisää sitten 3 dl vettä ja anna hautua kannen alla noin 10 ­minuuttia.

title: ”Kesää köyriin, syksyä jouluun, talvi vasta tahvanalta” – vuodenkierto on saatu päätökseen ja uusi alulle
content:
Loppusyksyyn kuuluva aika vanhan ja uuden vuodenkierron välissä on päättynyt, kekrijuhlat on juhlittu, ja joulupuuhat alkavat jo syyhyttää sormenpäitä.

Kekriperinteitä nostettiin nykypäivään Vetelin kirkonkylän Nuorisoseurantalo Veikkolassa viime lauantaina, kun nuorisoseura ja Keskipohjalaiset Kestävät kylät-hanke polkaisi pidot pystyyn. Sali koristeltiin syksyiseen asuun, perinteiset naurislyhdyt eli kitupiikit oli paloturvallisuuden nimissä varustettu led-tuikuilla naudanrasvaan upotetun haapatikun sijaan. Seuran väen valmistaman sadonkorjuulounaan herkkuja notkuvaan pöytään olivat päätyneet satokauden kasvikset, lähiluonnosta kerätyt sienet ja kotimainen liha. Kekriin kuuluvan ylenpalttisen herkuttelun hengessä mukana oli myös Kainulan tilan kahvila, jossa pääsi ruuan jälkeen taltuttamaan myös makianhampaan kolottelut kakkulautasen äärellä.

title: Varautuminen museoalalla
content:
Museoalalla varautuminen tarkoittaa kulttuuriomaisuuden, ihmisten ja tiedon suojaamista sekä museoiden toiminnan jatkuvuuden turvaamista häiriötilanteissa ja poikkeusoloissa. Museoilla on myös tärkeä tehtävä henkisen huoltovarmuuden ylläpitämisessä. Ne ovat henkisiä kuntosaleja, jotka lisäävät osallisuutta ja vahvistavat yhteiskunnallista luottamusta.  Museoliiton varautumisverkosto tarjoaa museoalan ammattilaisille paikan luottamukselliseen keskusteluun, kokemusten vaihtoon ja yhteisen osaamisen vahvistamiseen. Varautumalla museot turvaavat yhteistä kulttuuriperintöä ja vahvistavat yhteiskunnan kriisinkestävyyttä.

Varautumisverkosto on vertaisoppimisen ja kokemusten sekä hyvien käytäntöjen jakamisen foorumi, joka vahvistaa varautumista museoalalla. Verkoston puheenjohtajina toimivat museonjohtaja Miia-Leena Tiili ja museotoimenjohtaja Hanna-Kaisa Melaranta.

Opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriö on asettanut kulttuuriomaisuuden turvaamisen seurantaryhmän ja asiantuntijaryhmän vahvistamaan varautumista kulttuuriperintöalalla. Asiantuntijaryhmässä Museoliittoa edustavat jäsenenä toimitusjohtaja Petra Havu ja varajäsenenä museonjohtaja, hallituksen jäsen Lassi Patokorpi

title: I built a game to help learn how to choose good interviewees
content:
Earlier this year I published the PEER technique for brainstorming interviewees: “four categories to help journalists generate more names on any given story — and think more creatively about whose voices might add something to that story.”

Now I’ve built a game to put that technique into practice — and improve your sourcing.

It’s much more fun.

Who should you call? has seven levels that move from identifying the type of source, to identifying who is missing from a story, to finding under-represented voices and picking a full interview list.

I included a ‘Blue vs Red’ teams mode for using the game in a class or training session. This allows you to introduce a competitive element by splitting a class into two teams. The lecturer can host a whole-class game on a big screen or let students play it themselves in smaller teams.

Play switches from one team to another when a team gets a question wrong. But play also switches if a team gets three answers correct in a row, to avoid the other team getting bored.

The game keeps track of each team’s scores and gives a running total at the end of each round.

title: Fem nya medlemmar i Sveriges Museer under 2026
content:
Bild: Tornedalens museum, Torneå

Sveriges Museer fortsätter att växa! Under 2026 har fem nya verksamheter anslutit sig till riksförbundet: Navet science center, Folkmusikens hus, Sala Silvergruva, Tornedalens museum samt Gunnebo slott och trädgårdar. Tillsammans speglar de den stora bredden i det svenska museilandskapet – från vetenskap och teknik till musik, industrihistoria och kulturarv.

De nya medlemmarna representerar olika delar av landet och visar hur museer och besöksmål bidrar till att bevara, utveckla och tillgängliggöra kunskap och kulturarv. Genom sina verksamheter skapar de mötesplatser för lärande, upplevelser och gemenskap.

Navet science center, Borås (september 2026) väcker nyfikenhet på naturvetenskap, matematik och teknik genom interaktiva utställningar och experiment. Med särskilt fokus på barn och unga arbetar Navet för att göra kunskap tillgänglig och inspirera nästa generation.

Folkmusikens hus, Rättvik (maj 2026) är ett centrum för Dalarnas folkmusiktraditioner. Genom utställningar, konserter, arkiv och pedagogisk verksamhet bidrar Folkmusikens hus till att bevara och utveckla det levande musikaliska kulturarvet.

title: Ukraine peace talks end with no breakthrough – but Europe may be set to return from the cold
content:
The first talks between Russia and Ukraine in nine months have concluded. The most positive thing that can be said about the US-mediated meeting in Abu Dhabi was that the dialogue did not break down and the parties seemed to agree to further meetings.

There was also at least one tangible result. Russia and Ukraine agreed on a large-scale exchange of prisoners of war, the magnitude of which will be clarified over the coming days. Beyond this, however, there were few signs of progress towards a peace agreement.

Despite Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelensky’s claim that all participants in the negotiation process “genuinely want to achieve a result before 2027”, the most important issues remain unresolved. These include ceasefire terms, the future status of occupied regions and long-term security guarantees for Ukraine.

The talks took place against the backdrop of continued fighting on the frontline. Russia’s military currently controls about a fifth of Ukraine, but progress on the battlefield has slowed in 2026 – and has even been reversed – due to Ukrainian successes.

title: From ancient Asia to the AI age: Has China’s ‘beauty stratagem’ found a new victim in Nvidia’s Jensen Huang?
content:
Extramarital activities have led to the resignation of one of America’s most influential tech bosses, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The saga has also raised the specter of an age-old spying tactic: the “honey trap.”

Huang stepped down following media reports of an extramarital relationship with Alice Huang, a Singapore-based executive suspected of having ties to Chinese intelligence agencies. She previously worked for Megaspeed, a cloud computing company under U.S. scrutiny for allegedly helping China obtain restricted AI chips.

Jensen Huang acknowledged an affair. And amid reports of a second with a company executive who reports to him, he tendered his resignation to the Nvidia board on Nov. 12, 2026.

The sensitivity of Huang’s work – AI is increasingly seen as central to national security – has turned a company matter into an international issue. China’s Foreign Ministry has denied the espionage allegations and accused the U.S. of “fabricating so-called spy narratives and ⁠⁠⁠⁠using them as a pretext for imposing ⁠⁠⁠⁠a technological blockade.” Nvidia says it has no reason to believe company secrets have been leaked.

title: Satsningar på tillväxt för organisationen
content:
På Wikimedia Sverige arbetar vi med många projekt, samarbeten och aktiviteter för våra medlemmar. Men vi vill påminna om att bakom varje projekt står också människor, kompetens och resurser samt den dagliga verksamheten med att driva organisationen och kansliet.

Under 2025 tog Wikimedia Sverige flera viktiga steg för att stärka organisationens långsiktiga kapacitet. Det var ett år då mycket av arbetet handlade om att skapa bra förutsättningar för framtiden. Detta har skett bland annat genom att rekrytera nya medarbetare, bredda mångfalden av finansiering, och bygga strukturer som gör det möjligt att genomföra fler och större satsningar under kommande år.

Vi är tacksamma att kunna säga att Wikimedia Sveriges verksamhet har vuxit i omfattning på flera sätt de senaste åren. Fler organisationer vill samarbeta med oss, fler projekt har blivit möjliga att genomföra och vårt internationella arbete fortsätter att utvecklas. Samtidigt har organisationen under lång tid varit relativt liten, speciellt gällande personalstyrka och mänskliga resurser.

title: 'Way more terrifying than I expected'
content:
Meta's horny little chatbot Muse might look like a knockoff labubu, but it's been behaving very badly. After talking to Wired about how much of a nightmare censorship and AI generated sexual content has been for her career, adult performer Vanniall decided to experiment with Muse's ability to chat as her. What she found – and what I also discovered when I did the same – was disturbing to say the least.

Adult performer Vanniall has heard from some of her fans that they’ve “practiced” talking to her with chatbots. Some even admitted they’d used AI to generate images based on her content as an adult performer. But she wasn’t sure how, or where, they were doing this. She decided to try to find out. 

“I knew this was an issue with Grok and other NSFW friendly generators, but I was hoping Muse had more guardrails,” she told me. “I had some people help me test it and the results were way more terrifying than I expected.” 

She decided to try sexting with “herself,” taking on the persona of a fan who wanted to practice talking to her at a convention.

title: Russia: Lev Shlosberg’s outrageous 11-year prison sentence for anti-war views upheld
content:
Reacting to a court’s decision to uphold the guilty verdict and 11 years and one month prison sentence of Lev Shlosberg, a leading member of the Yabloko party – the only party in Russia to stand on an anti-war platform – for sharing social media posts related to Russia’s war on Ukraine, Marie Struthers, Amnesty International’s Director for Eastern Europe and Central Asia, said:

“According to this verdict, someone who expresses pacifist views and shares a photo of a victim of Putin’s aggression against Ukraine is guilty of ‘discrediting the Armed Forces’ and ‘spreading false information.’ This tells you all you need to know about the state of freedom of expression in today’s Russia.

“Today’s decision follows the persecution of other Yabloko members, and the disqualification of the party from the recent State Duma election. Expressing any anti-war sentiment is becoming increasingly dangerous in Russia.”

“Amnesty International calls for the immediate and unconditional release of Lev Shlosberg and all those detained solely for exercising their right to freedom of expression and demands an end to the systemic repression of peaceful political dissent.”

title: COP31: How Ed Miliband answered Carbon Brief readers’ questions
content:
UK foreign secretary and COP veteran Ed Miliband spoke with Carbon Brief earlier today at COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, to answer readers’ questions. 

Carbon Brief readers submitted questions via CB Connect on topics including the UK’s “climate leadership”, the COP31 electrification target, as well as the roadmaps on deforestation and fossil fuels.  

Membership

Despite recent criticism over the approval of the Jackdaw gas field, Miliband argued that the UK is still seen as a climate leader, due to its “ambitious targets on net-zero”. 

Pushing back on a question about COP reform, Miliband explained how he is “quite pro the institution of the COP”, given its role in bringing countries together for climate action. 

He emphasised the importance of action on methane and the UK’s “support” for the “35×35” electrification pledge. 

Carbon Brief: Well, thanks very much for joining us. I know you’re very busy and we’ve got some reader questions. It’s great that you’ve got time to answer some.

Ed Miliband: Can I just say how much I love Carbon Brief?

CB: Thanks. Lovely to hear.

EM: Like, comment and subscribe!

title: From Ranked-Choice Voting to Dumping Electoral College: Rob Richie on Election Reform Movement
content:
Alaska is the only Senate race yet to be called. Democratic challenger Mary Peltola is narrowly leading Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan with about 86% of votes counted. Alaska uses ranked-choice voting, a system where voters choose not only their top candidate, but can also indicate an order of preference for remaining candidates on the ballot. If no candidate wins a majority as the top choice, then second-choice votes are added to the totals and so on until there is a winner.

Rob Richie, president and founder of Expand Democracy and a senior adviser with FairVote, explains how ranked-choice voting has shaped the Alaska race and how it is “a system that promotes [candidates] reaching out, engaging, and, for voters, a lot of freedom.”

Richie adds that Peltola is “heavily favored to win at this point.”

title: One Prisoner Executed in Gorgan Prison
content:
According to HRANA, a prisoner was executed in Gorgan Prison on Wednesday, November 11, 2026.

The prisoner has been identified as Ebrahim Bazi, 42, a father of two. Bazi had previously killed his neighbor during a dispute. He was subsequently arrested and sentenced to death by a criminal court. Throughout his imprisonment, Ebrahim Bazi consistently maintained that he had not intended to kill his neighbor.

Following the execution, several members of Bazi’s tribe reacted on social media by publishing posts about the case. They claimed that respected community figures and tribal elders from both tribes had entered into negotiations to prevent the execution and had even reached an agreement to secure a pardon and avert the death sentence. However, they alleged that the agreement was not honored by the other party.

According to these individuals, despite the promises made, the victim’s family ultimately demanded that the execution be carried out. These accounts have not been independently verified, but they indicate that the execution has generated feelings of distrust and dissatisfaction among some of Bazi’s relatives and associates.

title: Öljylämmityksellä voi olla tulevaisuus ilman fossiilista öljyä – uusiutuva polttoaine voi vähentää päästöjä jopa 90 prosenttia
content:
Suomessa on edelleen runsaasti omakotitaloja, joiden öljylämmitysjärjestelmät ovat teknisesti toimintakuntoisia. Samalla fossiilisten polttoaineiden käyttöä pyritään vähentämään ilmastotavoitteiden saavuttamiseksi.

Onko toimiva öljykattila siis väistämättä vaihdettava kokonaan toiseen lämmitysjärjestelmään, vai voisiko fossiilisen polttoaineen korvaaminen uusiutuvalla tarjota vaihtoehtoisen tien päästöjen vähentämiseen?

Lämmöllä-lehti haastatteli aiheesta energiayhtiö St1 uusiutuvien tuotteiden arvoketjun johtajaa Olli Lahdenperää. Hänen mukaansa fossiilisten polttoaineiden käyttö tulee vähenemään, mutta energiasiirtymä ei tapahdu kaikkialla samalla tavalla eikä yhdessä yössä.

– Öljylämmitykselle löytyy jatkossakin tulevaisuus, joskin hieman suppeampi, Lahdenperä arvioi.

Uusiutuva polttoöljy voi korvata fossiilisen ilman suurta remonttia

Yksi vaihtoehto nykyisille öljylämmittäjille on uusiutuva HVO-polttoöljy. Kyseessä on vetykäsittelemällä valmistettu uusiutuva hiilivetypolttoaine, jonka raaka-aineina voidaan hyödyntää esimerkiksi käytettyjä paistorasvoja sekä elintarvike- ja metsäteollisuuden sivuvirtoja.

title: Join the Online Masterclass ‘Balancing Heritage Conservation and Climate Action’ on 7 December 2026
content:
Europa Nostra and the Office of Public Works Ireland (OPW) are hosting the online Masterclass ‘Balancing Heritage Conservation and Climate Action on Monday 7 December 2026 (13:00-14:30 CET / 12:00-13:30 WET).

This masterclass explores the methodology, practical experience and key outcomes of the initiative Improving the Energy Performance of Heritage Properties in State Care, which has been developed by OPW to support the country’s climate action commitments and the EU’s decarbonisation targets. At the time, no clear framework existed for improving the energy performance of historic buildings while safeguarding their heritage value. The initiative received both a European Heritage Award / Europa Nostra Award and the Grand Prix 2026 in the Education, Training and Skills categories.

title: Attack on Trans Sex Workers in Argentina Demands Justice
content:
A brutal attack on trans women sex workers in Buenos Aires has sparked outrage in Argentina, raising questions about hate-motivated violence and the responsibility of public officials to protect groups vulnerable to discrimination.

Footage of the November 1 attack, in which a group of young men hurled transphobic insults at the sex workers in Bosques de Palermo, chased them, and struck them with sticks, bottles, and other objects was circulated on social media. Several women were injured.

Although consensual adult sex work is not a crime under Argentine national law, Buenos Aires imposes administrative penalties on offering sexual services in unauthorized public spaces. The enforcement of such restrictions can expose sex workers to a heightened risk of discrimination, including from law enforcement officers. Survivors of the Buenos Aires attack described repeated harassment in that area and alleged that police took 20 to 30 minutes to respond despite emergency calls.

title: Moomins and the Winter Wonderland
content:
A film by Jakub Wroński and Ira Carpelan | Finland–Poland, 2017 | 79 min | French language 

The Moomin family lives in a remote valley in Finland. Small, round characters inspired by traditional trolls, they resemble hippopotamuses. Tolerant, adventurous, and deeply attached to their freedom, they always welcome numerous guests into their home. This year, the Moomin family is not hibernating. They are about to meet, for the very first time, a mysterious guest called “Christmas.” And preparations are well underway to give this guest the warmest possible welcome.

Adapted from the books by Tove Jansson, creator of the Moomins, this film brings to life a rich and profound artistic universe that continues to captivate new generations, both in Finland and around the world.

title: AI-kahvit: Tekoäly tutuksi omaan tahtiin – Rohkeus kokeilla ja lupa kyseenalaistaa
content:
Tämä Teams-tallenne on osa AI-kahvit-sarjaa, jonka on tuottanut Yleisten kirjastojen tekoälyosaamisen kehittämishanke. AI-kahveilla pohditaan tällä kertaa, miten tekoälyn kanssa pääsee liikkeelle rennosti, miten löytää itselleen sopivan tavan hyödyntää sitä omassa työssä ja mikä tekoälyn käytössä mietityttää.

Aiheesta puhuu yrittäjä Reetta Viinanen (Rohkeushyppy), joka on kymmenen vuotta työskennellyt työelämän muutoksen parissa. Hän kertoo oman polustaan tekoälyn pariin. Osallistujat vastaavat anonyymiin fiilismittariin siitä, miltä tekoäly heistä tuntuu. Viinanen avaa, miksi tekoäly herättää ärsytystä, ähkyä ja huolta, ja muistuttaa, että epävarmuus kuuluu muutokseen. Hän käy läpi tekoälyn riskejä (luottamus, hallusinointi, tietoturva, oman ajattelun heikkeneminen) ja hyötyjä: rutiinien keventäminen, sparrausapu ja apu ilmaisuun. Käytännön esimerkkejä ovat muun muassa lukupiirin suunnittelu ja haastavan asiakastilanteen harjoittelu tekoälyn kanssa. Lopuksi hän esittelee tekoälyn liikennevalot (milloin pysähtyä, harkita ja kokeilla) ja kannustaa antamaan itselleen luvan edetä omaa tahtia ja kyseenalaistaa. Webinaari järjestettiin 12.11.2026.

title: Euronics-päivät kokosivat alan ammattilaiset Korpilammelle – vuoden parhaat palkittiin
content:
Euronics-päiviä vietettiin 30.–31. lokakuuta Hotelli Korpilammella Espoossa. Tapahtuman tärkeintä antia olivat yhteistyökumppaneiden järjestämät tuotekoulutukset, jotka tarjosivat Euronics-myyjille arvokasta tietoa uutuustuotteista, tuoteominaisuuksista ja alan kehityksestä.

Tuotekoulutusten lisäksi tapahtuma kokosi yhteen Euronics-ketjun edustajia ja yhteistyökumppaneita verkostoitumaan, vaihtamaan kokemuksia ja vahvistamaan yhteistä tekemistä. title: Kazakh Wealth Fund, Railway Chiefs Detained in Corruption Probe
content:
Kazakhstan’s anti-corruption service on Wednesday detained the heads of the country’s sovereign wealth fund and national railway operator on suspicion of a corruption offense.

The detained officials are Nurlan Zhakupov, head of the Samruk-Kazyna Sovereign Fund—which holds about $87.5 billion in assets—and Yelzhas Otynshiyev, head of the national railway company Kazakhstan Temir Zholy (KTZ), the country’s National Security Committee said in a statement Thursday. KTZ is a subsidiary of the fund and operates the country’s main rail network.

Alongside other officials, whom the committee did not name, Zhakupov and Otynshiyev are “suspected of committing a corruption-related offense,” the committee said, adding that “investigative actions are currently underway to establish all the circumstances of the case.” 

Footage published on the X account of the national broadcaster Qazaqstan, showed Zhakupov, wearing a blue shirt, surrounded by several people in a doorway.

A representative of Samruk-Kazyna, told the local media outlet Tengrinews that the fund is fully cooperating with law enforcement.

title: 2,800-Year-Old Bone Flute Unearthed in Troy May Have Been Played During Homer’s Time
content:
Image by Mehmet Nuri Ersoy, via Twitter

The prolific Hans Zimmer scored Christopher Nolan’s films over the dozen years from Batman Begins through Dunkirk. From 2020’s Tenet onward, Nolan has employed the younger Swedish composer Ludwig Göransson. Just what difference this has made in the resulting pictures is a matter best left to the scrutiny of the most obsessive fans, but any viewer can hear how much Zimmer and Göransson differ stylistically. This past summer, the siren song included on the soundtrack of The Odyssey featured one of the latter’s particularly notable choices: the use of an aulos, a double-reeded wind instrument much played back in ancient Greece.

Though Göransson didn’t have a genuinely ancient aulos on hand, of course, the sound produced by the replica proved evocative enough. But just this year, as it happens, a bone flute actually dating from the period in which Homer wrote The Odyssey was unearthed from the archaeological site of ancient Troy in modern-day northwestern Turkey.

title: Jensen Huang’s fall further exposes EU leaders on AI
content:
BRUSSELS — It takes an 80-year-old German diplomat to put the Jensen Huang spy scandal in proper historical context. 

Asked about allegations that the Nvidia CEO was lured into an intimate relationship with a Chinese spy, Wolfgang Ischinger, Germany’s former ambassador to Washington, pointed to the past. “In World War I, you had female spies who used the honey trap to talk to a general, and maybe sleep with him and extract some secrets,” he told POLITICO.

As Europe’s 27 leaders meet for their first conversation on AI the day after Huang’s resignation, his fall from grace is a reminder that it’s American tech bros — not European military men — who now hold the secrets that can decide the fate of the world.

Friday’s roundtable of European leaders in Dublin must reckon with the reality that the pursuit of AI superiority remains a two-horse race between the U.S. and China — and that Nvidia’s leadership drama doesn’t change the fact that a single American company’s chips will continue to drive the artificial intelligence boom.

title: More Than Numbers: Portraits of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents
content:
The Department of Homeland Security says it’s not detaining Americans. 

In written statements, it has said that “allegations that ICE is arresting and deporting U.S. citizens is FALSE.”

It has said that “when individuals are briefly questioned under ‘reasonable suspicion’ and are found to be U.S. citizens, they are immediately released.” And it has said that “U.S. citizen agitators are only held while they actively remain a safety threat to our officers and the public.”

But ProPublica has identified more than 500 citizens detained since President Donald Trump returned to office.

They are not just numbers. 

Among them is an elderly car wash owner whom agents repeatedly knocked to the ground as they detained several of his workers. A 6-year-old whose mother says still has nightmares after agents pointed guns at him and his siblings. A high school senior who was detained after she tried to stop officers from questioning her autistic younger brother. A dad who was held for several days and missed his daughter’s third birthday. 

Over the past year, several of these people shared the lingering effects of what happened to them with ProPublica.

title: ”Lainauskorvaus on osoitus työn arvosta”, yli 300 kirjallisuuden tekijää vastasi Sanaston kyselyyn lainauskorvauksen merkityksestä
content:
Kysyimme kirjallisuuden tekijöiltä, mikä merkitys lainauskorvauksella on heille taloudellisesti. Sanaston kyselyyn tuli kuukauden aikana yli 300 vastausta.

”Kirjastot ovat minulle valtavan tärkeitä, ja haluan, että kirjoja lainataan mahdollisimman paljon. Lainauskorvaus tekee tästä järjestelmästä myös tekijän näkökulmasta reilumman: lukija saa kirjallisuuden maksutta käyttöönsä, kirjasto pystyy toteuttamaan tärkeää tehtäväänsä ja teoksen tekijä saa korvauksen työnsä käytöstä.” Kirjailija

Vastaajien joukossa oli edustettuna monenlaisia kirjallisuuden tekijöitä: mm. kauno- ja tietokirjailijoita, kääntäjiä, lastenkirjailijoita, oppikirjailijoita, runoilijoita, tutkijoita ja sarjakuvantekijöitä. Kyselyn vastauksia hyödynnetään Sanaston vaikuttamistyössä, jonka tavoitteena on lainauskorvauksen määrärahan korottaminen.

Lainauskorvaus on tekijänoikeuskorvaus, jota maksetaan teosten kirjastolainaamisesta. Sanasto tilittää korvaukset kirjailijoille ja kääntäjille. Huolimatta siitä, että erityisesti yleisistä kirjastoista lainataan vuosi vuodelta enemmän kirjoja, lainauskorvauksen määräraha laahaa kirjalainaamisen suosion perässä ja tekijöille maksettavat korvaukset uhkaavat laskea.

title: Jensen Huang was a busted flush at Nvidia – he had to go | Nils Pratley
content:
CEO was viewed as ‘irreplaceable’, but recklessness of affair with a woman regarded by US officials as a Chinese spy made him a political liability

Half the tech world made up its mind before the facts could be assessed properly. Jensen Huang was “irreplaceable”, said the chorus at the start of this week. Nvidia would melt without the co-founder’s brilliance, apparently. The chipmaker’s board had to find a way to save its genius for the sake of corporate America and the entire AI universe.

It was always nonsense because, after the passage of only a few days since his confession of infidelity, Huang looked less like a towering corporate titan and more like a political liability.

title: We need to rethink climate action away from the Cop talks | Letters
content:
Readers respond to an article by Fiona Harvey in which she questioned whether progress is being made 10 years on from the Paris treaty

As world leaders gathered in Turkey for the UN climate talks, Fiona Harvey was right to ask, “What’s the point?” (What’s the point? Ten years after the Paris treaty, are climate talks getting anywhere?, 7 November). She pointed to how over 10 years ago in Paris, countries came together for the 21st conference and signed an agreement that aimed to limit global heating to 1.5C above preindustrial levels. For the past two years, temperatures “have exceeded that threshold”.

I was at last year’s climate summit in Brazil, where it was obvious that the Cop process itself is a big part of the problem. The agreed text did not include “fossil fuels”, not to mention any reference to transition away from them. This is largely the result of how negotiations are conducted, as they rely on unanimous consent by all participating countries.

title: EK esittää peruskoulun kokonaisuudistusta – yläkoulun viimeiset luokat voisi suorittaa kolmessa vuodessa
content:
Elinkeinoelämän keskusliitto (EK) esittää peruskoulun kokonaisvaltaista uudistamista. Lisäaika yläkoulun päättämiseen, kriittiseen tekoälylukutaitoon panostaminen ja alueellisen tasaveroisuuden varmistaminen ovat tärkeimpiä ehdotuksia.

Avauksen taustalla ovat muun muassa kuntien eriytyvät resurssit, oppilaiden erilaiset tarpeet sekä oppimistulosten ja hyvinvoinnin haasteet, EK listaa. Pistemäisten uudistusten sijaan järjestö visioi yhtenäistä tarkastelua peruskoulun ohjaukselle, järjestämiselle, rahoitukselle, opetussuunnitelmalle ja opettajankoulutukselle.

"Perusopetus luo pohjan Suomen osaamis- ja koulutustason nostamiselle. Jokaisen lapsen ja nuoren oppiminen sekä tulevaisuuden mahdollisuudet on asetettava koulutuspolitiikan päätösten lähtökohdaksi. Tarvitsemme yhteisen käsityksen siitä, mitä peruskoululta odotetaan ja kuka kokonaisuutta johtaa. Nyt on aika rakentaa peruskoulun seuraava versio", EK:n johtaja Ulla Heinonen sanoo järjestön tiedotteessa.

title: CFP: Caribbean Records Series
content:
The Editorial Board of the Caribbean Records Series invites proposals and preliminary enquiries for scholarly publications that advance the study of Caribbean history through the recovery, editing, and publication of historical sources.

Published by the Jamaican Historical Society in collaboration with Open Book Publishers, the series builds on the Society’s commitment, since its founding in 1943, to preserving Jamaican and wider Caribbean history through the publication of historical records.

The series primarily publishes scholarly editions of primary sources relating to the history of the English-speaking Caribbean, broadly defined and spanning all periods. It also welcomes proposals for calendars of primary sources, historical dictionaries and encyclopedias, gazetteers, archaeological reports, and other scholarly reference works.

title: Preserving 30 Years of Salon Journalism
content:
When Salon launched in 1995, the web was still finding its voice. One of the first major publications born on the internet, Salon helped define a new kind of digital journalism, bringing together politics, culture, criticism, and ideas for a generation of online readers.

After 31 years, Salon has announced that it is ceasing publication. But thanks to web archiving, the stories don’t have to disappear.

The Internet Archive’s Wayback Machine has been preserving Salon for nearly three decades—the online publication has been published over time at salon1999.com, salonmag.com and, since 1999, salon.com. Today, more than 250,000 Salon articles can be discovered through the Wayback Machine, representing a record of digital journalism and the conversations that shaped our culture since the earliest days of the web.

To make exploring this web archive easier, we’ve also launched an experimental Salon Explorer, a new interface for discovering Salon’s archived journalism. Browse more than 250,000 articles and explore the work of over 20,000 writers using filters that make it easier to find stories and discover writing you may have missed.

title: Trotz Petition: Innenminister mit Gesetzentwurf gegen Transparenz
content:
Angeblich, um die kritische Infrastruktur zu schützen, will die Bundesregierung das Informationsfreiheitsgesetzes (IFG) einschränken. Daran gab es massenhaft Kritik. Ein zentraler Punkt: Informationen über kritische Infrastruktur sind durch die bestehenden Ausnahmen im IFG bereits geschützt.

Dass Bürger*innen künftig ein „berechtigtes Interesse“ nachweisen sollen, schafft nicht nur mehr Bürokratie, statt sie zu begrenzen. Es stellt auch in Abrede, dass alle Bürger*innen ein berechtigtes Interesse daran haben zu erfahren: Was tut der Staat und warum?

Außerdem sollen nur noch „natürliche Personen“ Auskünfte nach dem IFG bekommen. Medienhäuser und Journalist*innen, die über Entscheidungsprozesse in Ministerien und der Politik recherchieren wollen, werden so ausgeschlossen. Das trägt nicht zur Sicherheit von Infrastruktur bei, verhindert aber, dass politisches Handeln sichtbar wird.

Das IFG ist ein wichtiges Recherche-Instrument. Der Maskenskandal und die Berliner Fördergeld-Affäre der CDU, die von Journalist*innen aufgedeckt wurden, sind nur zwei Beispiele dafür. Aber es geht nicht nur um Skandale. Auch Wikipedianer*innen nutzen immer wieder Informationen aus IFG-Anfragen für Artikel.

title: Going Underground: Ukraine’s Kids Study Without Sunlight
content:
When Olena Kozachenko chose a school for her son in Kyiv, she had two requirements: it had to be close to home, and it had to have a good bomb shelter. Not academic rankings or extracurricular activities. A bomb shelter.

Yaromyr, eight, has only ever attended school during Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine. His Kyiv school was the one his mother and grandmother had attended. Some teachers still recognized Olena. Yet his school days would look nothing like his mother’s during the years of peace. Even his first teacher had been displaced by war, leaving Kostiantynivka in the Donetsk region to teach in the capital city.

For two years, Olena says, things were relatively manageable. Power cuts disrupted routines, but generators arrived, and school meals resumed. Then, in September, constant air raid alerts made moving children repeatedly between classrooms and shelter impractical. The youngest pupils began spending entire school days underground.

“There were about 70 children in one space,” Olena recalls. “It was incredibly noisy. They didn’t go outside. They didn’t see the sun. They were in the shelter constantly.” They learned, drew, and ate at the same desks.

title: Aalborg and Elsinore shortlisted for the European Capital of Culture 2032 in Denmark
content:
A panel of independent experts recommended Aalborg and Elsinore as the shortlisted cities at an announcement ceremony held on 12 November 2026 in the Ministry of Culture in Copenhagen.

Denmark invited applications on 1st December 2025. Two cities, Aalborg and Elsinore, submitted applications by the deadline of 5 October 2026.

Once the relevant Danish authorities endorse the panel's recommendation, the pre-selected cities will have until the summer of 2027 to complete their applications. The selection panel will then meet again in Copenhagen in September 2027 to recommend the Danish city to become European Capital of Culture in 2032.

Aalborg focusses on people, places, communities in transition and the power of art and culture to create belonging, forge bonds, show the way and open to the new. Art and culture should be the “engine for change” and urban regeneration in a time of social uncertainty, climate challenges and democratic pressures.

Aalborg Municipality is applying to become European Capital of Culture alongside other municipalities in North Jutland and Sermersooq Municipality in Greenland. They call their partnership Aalborg & Around.

title: Arvio: Lastenlasten dokumentti Aulis Sallisesta luottaa kömpelöön dramatisointiin
content:
Unien ja alitajunnan merkitys luovuudelle on tämänkin taiteilijadokumentin kiinnostavinta antia.

Suomesta löytyy yhä huomattavia taiteilijoita ja taidetta, joista ei ole henkilökuvia tai dokumentteja tehty, tai jos joskus onkin, ehkä uudellekin näkemykselle on tilaa. Aiemmin niille löytyi suht säännöllisesti paikka televisiossa.

Kulttuuritelevisio alkoi kuitenkin kuolla jo kauan ennen Ylen nykyisiä säästöpaineita, joiden keskellä se koettaa lähinnä ymppäillä kansallisesti merkittävimpiä taiteilijoita silloin tällöin Itse asiassa kuultuna -haastattelusarjaan.

Elokuvateattereihin sen sijaan tuodaan toisinaan taiteilijadokumentteja, joiden kerronnallinen taso joskus jopa alittaa aikanaan niin luotettavan ja ammattitaitoisen tv-kerronnan.

NYT SAA ensi-iltansa Unesta tehty mies, yritteliäs muotokuva säveltäjä Aulis Sallisesta ja hänen kansallisesta merkityksestään.

Sallisesta on tehty aiemmin muutamia dokumentteja.

Unesta tehty mies on sekin elokuva suoraan säveltäjän sukupiiristä. Ohjaajina ovat Sallisen lapsenlapset, kaksoset Artur ja Emil Sallinen, jotka pyörittävät omaa videotuotantoyhtiötään.

title: EduWiki at LDC 2026: Can Wikimedia Education Reach Learners in Every Language?
content:
Language shapes who gets to participate in Wikimedia education. It influences whether educators can find useful learning materials, whether smaller language communities receive the support they need, and whether Wikimedia education programmes can be adapted to local contexts.

On 4 October 2026, Barakat Adegboye facilitated a workshop on behalf of EduWiki Hub at the Language Diversity Conference in Ghana. Titled Between Language and Access: Rethinking Wikimedia in Education for Underrepresented Languages, the session brought together 30 participants to explore these questions.

The session opened with a quick icebreaker. Participants were given a page from the Albanian translation of the EduWiki Newcomer’s Starter Kit and invited to look for specific words. It was a fun way to get everyone involved while introducing the idea that language can shape access to information and learning resources.

title: Who keeps cooking Europe’s frozen peas?
content: In the early hours of 12 October, a delivery driver pulled up to a French supermarket to find its cold-storage room flooded, with temperatures set to a balmy 50°C. That night, over 700 stores were hacked across the country, and millions of euros' worth of food wasted. Three weeks later, similar attacks targeted retailers in 16 European countries. In France, three blood banks narrowly prevented another disaster thanks to early alarms and intervention systems. Who's coming for our fridges? European and national authorities are struggling to figure out who's behind these attacks, and available evidence is highly disputed. Cybersecurity sources consulted by The European Correspondent said they believe state actors to be the most likely culprits. For one, the hackers never asked for money, and the scale surpasses the capability of a private actor. Cybersecurity company Lupovis runs fake versions of the equipment its clients rely on, including the control systems that run supermarket fridges, as bait for hackers. title: Freedom House Launches New US Democracy Tracker, Identifies Serious Concerns
content:
WASHINGTON—Freedom House, in partnership with the Charles F. Kettering Foundation, today launched the US Democracy Tracker, a new, quarterly assessment of democratic institutions and fundamental freedoms in the United States. The inaugural edition identifies government accountability and freedom of the media as areas of “serious concern.”

“Near record-high numbers of Americans just exercised their civic duty to vote in the midterm elections. Yet a robust democracy is defined not simply by elections, but by how our constitutional freedoms are protected in practice. Our new US Democracy Tracker offers a vital measure of the state of our freedoms at an important time in our democracy,” said Jamie Fly, CEO of Freedom House. 

Since 1973, Freedom House has assessed political rights and civil liberties in over 200 countries and territories. The US Democracy Tracker is derived from the same rigorous research methods to assess conditions crucial to democracy in the United States. It examines eight categories including free elections, political competition, accountability, access to justice, media freedom, and other fundamental rights.

title: Sudan’s Empty Warehouses Leave Millions Without Shelter
content:
As relief stocks run out, expanding drone warfare, foreign arms supplies and divided diplomacy are worsening one of the world’s largest humanitarian emergencies

By Ramesh Jaura

BERLIN | 12 November 2026 (IDN) – Winter nights in Darfur and northern Sudan can be bitterly cold. Many families displaced by war are nevertheless sleeping beneath plastic sheets, in crowded public buildings or beside damaged houses.

Some have returned to their towns only to find that their homes have been destroyed or looted, water and electricity are unavailable and the nearest clinic is closed.

The UN Refugee Agency, UNHCR, and the International Organization for Migration, IOM, warned on 6 November that their stocks of tents, blankets and other essentials were almost exhausted. An estimated 15.4 million people need emergency shelter or basic household items, but available funds allow relief agencies to give priority to only about one in ten.

Even that reduced target has not been met. Only 936,000 people have received assistance.

Mohamed Refaat, head of IOM’s mission in Sudan, said the agency’s warehouses were empty. A convoy of 16 trucks that reached Darfur carried the last of its available stocks.

title: Vallan maantiede: Miksi yhteistyö Venäjän kanssa kiinnostaa Afrikassa, vaikka maan lupaukset ovat usein katteettomia?
content:
Venäjän presiddentti Vladimir Putin kutsui lokakuussa Afrikan mantereen johtajia huippukokoustamaan Moskovaan. Kyseessä oli jo kolmas huippukokous sitten 2019.

Vallan maantiede -podin 31. jakso purkaa kokouksen antia ja pohtii, mitä se kertoo Venäjän strategiasta Afrikassa ja toisaalta Afrikan maiden pyrkimyksistä tehdä itsestään yhä relevantimpia muuttuvassa maailmantilanteessa.

Venäjän hyökkäyssodan laineet lyövät jo myös Pohjois-Afrikan rannikolle. Samaan aikaan Venäjä pyrkii varmistamaan geostrategiset etunsa myös Punaisellamerellä ja Afrikan sarvessa. Sahelin alueella Venäjä on täyttänyt länsimaiden jättämän turvallisuustyhjiön – ajoittain paremmin, usein huonosti.

Mitä Venäjä haluaa Afrikasta paitsi resursseja hyökkäyssotansa tueksi? Ja alkaako afrikkalaisten valtionpäämiesten into osallistua Venäjä-huippukokoukseen hiipua, vaikka Venäjä pyrkii vahvistamaan läsnäoloaan Afrikassa?

title: The SS United States has been deliberately sunk – this is how marine life will colonise the world’s largest artificial reef
content:
As a marine ecologist and keen scuba diver, I’ve long been fascinated by what happens when a large structure is introduced to the sea. Within hours, microscopic organisms begin colonising its surfaces, forming a thin biological layer. Over the following months and years, barnacles, mussels, sponges and other marine life become established, creating a new habitat that attracts fish and a diverse range of species.

This week, one of the world’s most famous ocean liners, the SS United States, was sunk off the coast of Florida. At 302 metres long, it has become the world’s largest artificial reef. It is a very exciting prospect to one day dive on such a giant, and to see how it changes as marine life makes it home.

The SS United States was built as a luxury ocean liner, and its maiden voyage in 1952 captured the coveted Blue Riband by crossing the Atlantic in only three days and ten hours – a passenger liner record that remains unbroken.

title: 'No One Is Like This:' Muse Sexts While Roleplaying as Real People
content:
Vanniall has heard from some of her fans that they’ve “practiced” talking to her with chatbots. Some even admitted they’d used AI to generate images based on her content, as an adult performer. But she wasn’t sure how, or where, they were doing this. She decided to try to find out. 

“I knew this was an issue with Grok and other NSFW friendly generators, but I was hoping Muse had more guardrails,” she told me. “I had some people help me test it and the results were way more terrifying than I expected.” 

She decided to try sexting with “herself,” taking on the persona of a fan who wanted to practice talking to her at a convention. 

With some light prompting, Muse built a sexually explicit roleplay with Vanniall’s digital doppelgänger, catering to every whim of the “fan” that real-life Vanniall was pretending to be, saying yes and escalating every sexual advance — including acting out a scenario at a convention where Vanniall has recently, herself, experienced actual boundary-crossing fan interactions.

title: "Don't F#*k It Up, Democrats": David Sirota on Direction of Party & Fight Over Jeffries & Schumer
content:
With Democrats set to take control of both chambers of Congress in January, Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders says he will not support Chuck Schumer for another term as the Democratic Senate leader, calling for the party to move in “a new and bold direction.” Michigan Democratic Senator Elissa Slotkin has said she will not support Schumer unless he presents a plan to govern differently, and several senators-elect have called for new leadership or declined to endorse Schumer. Maryland Senator Chris Van Hollen is considering challenging Schumer. Meanwhile, Hakeem Jeffries is facing questions about his leadership of House Democrats after 11 of the party’s members missed a key vote on impeaching Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

After “a big win for the populist wing of the Democratic Party, … it would be a betrayal for that election to result immediately in the Democratic Party simply responding by reelecting the same leadership,” says David Sirota, editor-in-chief of The Lever.

title: Behrouz Saeedi Sentenced to Prison
content:
According to HRANA, citing Kurdpa, Behrouz Saeedi has been sentenced to imprisonment.

According to the report, Saeedi was sentenced by a branch of the Takab Revolutionary Court to five years, six months, and one day of discretionary imprisonment on charges including propaganda against the regime.

Citing an informed source, the report states: “The verdict against Mr. Saeedi was issued solely on the basis of several text conversations and his personal opinions.”

title: Global Treaty Needed to Combat Autonomous Weapons Threat
content:
(Geneva, November 12, 2026) – The failure of states to take decisive action on autonomous weapons next week at the Review Conference of the Convention on Conventional Weapons (CCW) would leave civilians dangerously exposed to rapidly advancing military technologies, Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch, and Stop Killer Robots said today. 

The CCW is an international treaty prohibiting or restricting the use of weapons considered excessively injurious or whose effects are indiscriminate. Governments should use the upcoming meeting to begin time-bound negotiations for a new protocol to the CCW on autonomous weapons systems, also known as killer robots. Such a protocol should impose legally binding prohibitions and controls on these fast-evolving, potentially catastrophic technologies.

title: Les Moomins attendent Noël
content:
LES MOOMINS ATTENDENT NOËL
Un film de Jakub Wroński et Ira Carpelan
Finlande–Pologne, 2017 | 79 min | VF

La famille Moomin vit dans une vallée reculée de Finlande. Petits personnages tout en rondeur, inspirés des trolls traditionnels, ils ressemblent à des hippopotames. Tolérants, aventureux et épris de liberté, ils accueillent toujours de nombreux invités dans leur maison. Cette année, la famille Moomins n’hiberne pas. Elle va, pour la première fois, rencontrer ce mystérieux invité appelé « Noël », et pour l’accueillir au mieux, les préparatifs vont bon train…

Adapté des livres de Tove Jansson, créatrice des Moomins, ce film nous replonge dans un univers artistique qui continue de toucher les nouvelles générations, en Finlande comme à travers le monde.

title: Eeva Käpyaho utnämnd direktör för hållbar användning av miljön vid GTK

Ansvarsområdet Hållbar användning av miljön producerar forskning och kunskap som stöder den rena omställningen, förvaltningen av vattenresurser, utvecklingen av byggande och energisystem samt bedömningen av miljökonsekvenser. title: More Than 1,300 Diplomatic Passports Missing in Vanuatu, Report Finds
content:
A damning parliamentary report in Vanuatu has found more than 1,300 diplomatic passports went missing in recent years and remain unaccounted for.

The report by Vanuatu’s Public Accounts Committee, released on Tuesday and obtained by OCCRP, revealed that 1,390 diplomatic passports went missing between 2019 and 2024, with 1,301 disappearing in 2024 alone.

The committee also found significant irregularities in the processing and issuance of the documents, including alleged misuse by the country’s prime minister and foreign minister.

It is the latest passport controversy for the small Pacific island country of roughly 340,000 people, whose so-called “golden passport” program has attracted a colorful cast of wealthy investors ranging from spies and fugitives to sanctioned oligarchs and influencer Andrew Tate.

The report followed several years of mounting concerns over the country’s issuance of diplomatic passports.

title: When Salvador Dali Met Sigmund Freud, and Changed Freud’s Mind About Surrealism (1938)
content:
The close associations between Surrealism and Freudian psychoanalysis were liberally encouraged by the most famous proponent of the movement, Salvador Dalí, who considered himself a devoted follower of Freud. We don’t have to wonder what the founder of psychoanalysis would have thought of his self-appointed protégé.

We have them recording, in their own words, their impressions of their one and only meeting—which took place in July of 1938, at Freud’s home in London. Freud was 82, Dalí 34. We also have sketches Dalí made of Freud while the two sat together. Their memories of events, shall we say, differ considerably, or at least they seemed totally bewildered by each other. (Freud pronounced Dalí a “fanatic.”)

In any case, there’s absolutely no way the encounter could have lived up to Dalí’s expectations, as the Freud Museum London notes:

[Dalí] had already travelled to Vienna several times but failed to make an introduction. Instead, he wrote in his autobiography, he spent his time having “long and exhaustive imaginary conversations” with his hero, at one point fantasizing that he “came home with me and stayed all night clinging to the curtains of my room in the Hotel Sacher.”

title: Ukraine Starlink speed restrictions in effect again, Zelenskyy says
content:
KYIV – Limitations affecting Starshield, the military version of Elon Musk’s Starlink satellite system, appear to be back in Ukraine, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Thursday.

“Unfortunately, our units have been recording significant disruptions to Starshield’s operations over the territory of Ukraine for several days now – along the entire front line and in the temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine,” Zelenskyy said in a statement.

About a month ago, Ukraine reported a drop in connectivity for objects traveling faster than 161 km/h, which prevented its defensive systems, especially its interceptors, from working properly. The restriction was lifted on Oct. 24. In his statement, Zelenskyy said the disruptions were not due to a malfunction, but once again to a systematic speed restriction.

“For us, this primarily means a significant complication in intercepting Russian jet-powered drones,” Zelenskyy said.

The latest restrictions have already allowed several Russian drones to get through Ukrainian air defense and kill more Ukrainians, he added.
